# bugs #3990: Compiling smallserpent for stm8 with --model-large does not end on one host

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3990/
- Category: [Information needed from the reporter](../../needs-info.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Ask the reporter for the Boost version of the host on which the compiler did not stop.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17176 both cases of `support/regression/tests/smallserpent.c.in` compile for stm8 with
`--model-large` and the other options of the command line in the second comment. The encryption
case took 215 s and the decryption case 220 s, while both compilers ran at once on two CPUs. Each
ended with exit code 0 and an object file.

The compiler was built with GCC 14.2.0 and Boost 1.83 on Debian 13, without the treedec library.
The reporter's host is also Debian 13. r16545, the revision of the ticket, was not built.

`support/regression/MakeList` on r17176 still excludes the test for stm8-large, with a reference
to this ticket. mcs51 was not tested, because the test disables itself for mcs51 for lack of code
memory.

## Reason

The reporter found that the hang depends on an old Boost version on one machine and did not name
the version. The backtrace in the ticket ends in the sort of the assignment list in
`tree_dec_lospre_forget` in `src/SDCClospre.hpp`, which is the same code for every port. The
version check that the last comment proposes for `src/SDCClospre.cc` needs that version number,
and only the reporter has it.
